sections.title: From Concrete to Abstract: The Shift
lecture_lines: Vectors aren't just arrows in space.
Matrices follow the same addition laws.
Abstraction unlocks new ways to compute.

sections.title: The Eight Axioms: Defining the Space
lecture_lines: Vector spaces follow eight formal axioms.
Closure ensures results stay within the space.

sections.title: Non-Traditional Examples: Beyond Arrows
lecture_lines: Unusual sets can form vector spaces.
Degree-two polynomials behave identically to 3D space.

sections.title: Visualization: Mapping Abstract Spaces
lecture_lines: Abstract spaces can be mapped visually.
Isomorphisms translate complex structures to grids.
Sound waves map onto coordinate systems.

sections.title: Summary & Application
lecture_lines: Abstract spaces are sets with rules.
Feature spaces drive modern machine learning.
Abstraction enables powerful predictive mathematical tools.
